notes: Final controller (right/left-hand punch chosen by bag side, feet planted, whole-body IK with CoM feedback and a forward CoM lean) succeeded in 20/20 practice-setup episodes (seeds 0-19, bag at 0.38,-0.15,1; swing 34-39 cm, max tilt under 4 deg). Five extra tests with the bag hung low (z 0.30-0.42 m) all failed (robot fell or no strike), so the 0.8 combines both sets; those low positions were not run with motion files and the controller does not handle bags below chest height or reach beyond about x=0.45 m reliably.
